items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 October 2026 4:11am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 14 October 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Rapidly deepening area of low pressure approaching Iceland as a ridge of high pressure covers much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, quickly increasing 5 or 6, further increasing 6 or 7 into the afternoon and occasionally gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 6 to gale 8, decreasing 5 to 7 through the morning, veering west or northwest 3 or 4 in the afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate in the afternoon, then slight later.


##Weather##

Rain quickly arriving, heavy at times, gradually clearing towards the southeast in the afternoon or evening. Fair later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in heavy rain, becoming good later.
